Message.Name: System Time Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate the “seconds” part of the timestamp that is applicable to all messages that are sent in the current second.

Field.Name: Seconds
Field.Description: Seconds part of the time that applies to all messages that gets disseminated until this message gets sent again.

Message.Name: Series Update Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate all Option series traded on PEARL for the current session. The product ID sent in this message is what will be disseminated in Top of Market BBO and Last Sale messages.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Time at which this product is added/updated on PEARL system today.

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: PEARL Product ID mapped to a given option. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Stock Symbol for the option.

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Option Security Symbol

Field.Name: Expiration Date
Field.Description: Expiration date of the option in YYYYMMDD format

Field.Name: Strike Price
Field.Description: Explicit strike price of the option. Refer to data types for field processing notes

Field.Name: Call or Put
Field.Description: Option Type

Field.Name: Opening Time
Field.Description: Expressed in HH:MM:SS format. Eg: 09:30:00

Field.Name: Closing Time
Field.Description: Expressed in HH:MM:SS format. Eg: 16:15:00

Field.Name: Active on PEARL
Field.Description: Indicates if this symbol is tradable on PEARL in the current session:

Field.Name: PEARL BBO Posting Increment Indicator
Field.Description: This is the Minimum Price Variation as agreed to by the Options industry (penny pilot program) and as published by PEARL

Field.Name: Liquidity Acceptance Increment Indicator
Field.Description: This is the Minimum Price Variation for Quote/Order acceptance as per PEARL rules

Field.Name: Opening Underlying Market Code
Field.Description: Options opening will be triggered on receipt of Opening quote/trade from this Underlying market:

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: ** Reserved for future use **

Message.Name: System State Message
Message.Description: This message format is used to notify the firms of the state changes of the system. This is a notification that applies to each Underlying group. Firms can use notifications as triggers in their system to ensure electronic synchronization of systems.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Time at which this was generated by PEARL system.

Field.Name: ToM Version
Field.Description: Eg: TOM1.0

Field.Name: Session ID
Field.Description: PEARL assigned ID for the current trading session

Field.Name: System Status
Field.Description: Current system status:

Field.Description: PEARL Product ID mapped to a given option. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: PBBO Price
Field.Description: PEARL Best price at the time stated in Timestamp and side specified in Message Type

Field.Name: PBBO Size
Field.Description: Aggregate size at PEARL Best Price at the time stated in Timestamp and side specified in Message Type

Field.Name: PBBO Priority Customer Size
Field.Description: Aggregate size of Priority Customer contracts at the PEARL Best Price

Field.Name: PBBO Condition

Message.Name: Last Sale Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate Trades that are resulting from executions on PEARL during the current trading session.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Seconds part of the time that applies to all messages that gets disseminated until this message gets sent again.

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: PEARL Product ID mapped to a given option. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Unique Trade ID assigned to every Trade.

Field.Name: Correction Number
Field.Description: Trade correction number. 0 for New trades. Greater than or equal to 0 for trades resulting from corrections/adjustments.

Field.Name: Reference Trade ID
Field.Description: 0 (zero) if new trade. Trade ID of the original trade if this trade originated as a correction of the original trade.

Field.Name: Reference Correction Number
Field.Description: Correction Number of the trade that was just corrected/adjusted. 0 for new trades.

Field.Name: Trade Price
Field.Description: Price at which this product traded

Field.Name: Trade Size
Field.Description: Number of contracts executed in this trade

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Valid Values: Please refer to Appendix A

Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate canceled Trades that are resulting from Trade cancellations or corrections on PEARL during the current trading session.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Seconds part of the time that applies to all messages that gets disseminated until this message gets sent again.

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: PEARL Product ID mapped to a given option. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Unique Trade ID assigned to every Trade.

Field.Name: Correction Number
Field.Description: Trade correction number. 0 for New trades. Greater than or equal to 0 for trades resulting from corrections/adjustments.

Field.Name: Trade Price
Field.Description: Price at which this product traded

Field.Name: Trade Size
Field.Description: Number of contracts executed in this trade

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Valid Values: Please refer to Appendix A

Message.Description: This message format will be used to notify firms of changes to the trading status of all the options of an underlying.

Field.Name: Timestamp

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol

Field.Name: Expected Event Time: Seconds Part
Field.Description: Seconds portion of the expected time of the event. Always use in conjunction with the Nano-seconds part field.

Field.Name: Expected Event Time: Nano-Seconds Part
Field.Description: Nano-seconds portion of the expected time of the event. Specifies number of nano-seconds since the seconds specified in “Expected Event Time Seconds” field.
